setup.title: Welcome to {{name}}
setup.subtitle: Choose where the launcher keeps game files, versions and worlds.
setup.hint: You can change this later in Settings.

changelog.title: Changelog of {{id}}
changelog.none: Mojang has no patch notes for this version in the launcher (they start at 1.13).

versions.offlineRefresh: No internet connection. Still showing the saved list.
versions.noList: The version list hasn't been downloaded yet, and there's no internet connection.
versions.refreshFailed: Couldn't check for new versions right now. Still showing the saved list.

loaders.label: Mod loader
loaders.unsupportedHint: {{name}} isn't available for {{version}}. Pick another loader or version.

play.crashed: {{name}} crashed (exit code {{code}}). Check the game log.
play.needAccount: Create or pick an account in the top bar to play.
play.needBoth: Pick a profile, and an account in the top bar, to play.
play.runningHint: Already running. Another game of this profile needs a different account, and uses the same profile folder: open a different world in each.
play.accountPlaying: {{name}} is already playing this profile. Pick another account in the top bar to play it again.
play.backupFailed: Couldn't back up {{names}} before the start; the game started anyway.

log.title: Game log
log.empty: The game's output appears here while it runs.

memory.label: Maximum memory
memory.hint: How much RAM the game may use. 2048–4096 MB suits most vanilla versions.
memory.tooMuch: That's more than 75% of this computer's memory. The rest of the system may slow down.

dataDir.label: Data folder
dataDir.moveHint: Profiles, worlds, mods, accounts and game files go with it. The folder must be empty.
dataDir.emptyHint: The current folder stays as it is; the launcher starts fresh in the new one.
dataDir.keepOpen: Keep the launcher open until it's done; it restarts by itself.

args.jvmHint: Added after the version's own, e.g. -XX:+UseG1GC. Quote values with spaces.
args.gameHint: Added after the version's own, e.g. --width 1280 --height 720.
args.memoryFlags: -Xmx and -Xms are set by Memory; leave them out here.

java.title: Java
java.managedHint: Mojang's Java builds. Each Minecraft version downloads the one it needs when you play; you can also install them here.
java.offline: Mojang's Java list couldn't be loaded (no internet?). Only installed runtimes are shown.
java.name: Java {{major}}
java.systemHint: Java installed outside the launcher (JAVA_HOME, PATH and the usual install folders). Shown for information; the launcher uses its own runtimes.
java.removeBody: Its files are deleted. It's downloaded again if a version needs it.
java.removeUsed: Used by {{versions}}. Its files are deleted and downloaded again the next time one of them is played.

versionList.title: Version list
versionList.hint: Releases are always shown. A profile on a hidden type keeps working.

backups.title: Backups
backups.beforeStart: Before the game starts (Play waits for it)
backups.afterExit: After the game closes (in the background)
backups.newestKept: The newest backup of each world is always kept.
backups.unchangedHint: A world that hasn't changed since its last backup isn't backed up again.

errors.OFFLINE: Can't reach Mojang's servers. Check your internet connection and try again.
errors.DOWNLOAD_FAILED: A download failed. Try again; finished files are kept.
errors.HASH_MISMATCH: A downloaded file was damaged. Try again.
errors.JAVA_UNAVAILABLE: Mojang doesn't provide Java for this computer's system.
errors.INVALID_USERNAME: Usernames are 3–16 characters: letters, numbers and _ only.
errors.VERSION_UNKNOWN: This version wasn't found. Check for new versions and try again.
errors.BUSY: Wait for the install to finish, or cancel it first.
errors.MISSING_FILE: A required file is missing and can't be downloaded. Try Repair.
errors.NOT_FOUND: The server doesn't have this file. Try again later.
errors.BAD_RESPONSE: The server sent something unexpected. Try again later.
errors.LOADER_UNSUPPORTED: This mod loader has no stable build for this version yet.
errors.generic: Something went wrong. See the launcher log for details.
errors.PROFILE_NOT_FOUND: This profile doesn't exist any more.
errors.INVALID_PROFILE: Check the profile's name, version and settings.
errors.VERSION_IN_USE: Profiles or other installs use this version.
errors.WORLD_NOT_LINKED: This world can't be moved because the data folder doesn't support links.
errors.WORLD_NOT_FOUND: This world doesn't exist any more.
errors.MOD_INCOMPATIBLE: This mod doesn't fit the profile's loader or Minecraft version.
errors.MOD_NOT_FOUND: This mod isn't in the library any more.
errors.FILE_CHANGED: The file changed while it was being added. Try again.
errors.MODRINTH_ERROR: Modrinth didn't answer as expected. Try again later.
errors.MOD_DEPENDENCY_MISSING: A mod it needs has no version for this profile.
errors.PLAN_EXPIRED: This search is too old. Search again, then press Download.
errors.MOD_REQUIRED: Another enabled mod needs this one. Untick that mod first.
errors.MOD_NO_SOURCE: This mod can't be downloaded again: its site isn't known, or no longer has this file.
errors.ACCOUNT_NAME_TAKEN: Another account already has that name (names ignore case).
errors.ACCOUNT_PLAYING: That account is already playing this profile. Pick another account.
errors.DATA_DIR_NOT_EMPTY: Choose an empty folder to move your data into.
errors.MOD_BULK_BUSY: A mod download is already running. Wait for it to finish.
errors.INVALID_TARGET: Choose a version and a loader.
errors.BACKUP_DAMAGED: This backup is damaged and can't be restored.
errors.NOT_A_PACK: Only resource pack .zip files can be added.
errors.PACK_NESTED: The pack is one folder down inside the zip. Use the folder inside it instead.
errors.PACK_NOT_FOUND: This resource pack isn't in the library.
errors.PACKS_VERSION_UNKNOWN: Launch this profile once first, so the launcher knows which packs fit it.
errors.PACKS_UNSUPPORTED: This Minecraft version uses texture packs, which the launcher doesn't manage.
errors.OPTIONS_UNWRITABLE: The game's options.txt couldn't be saved.
errors.PACK_NO_VERSION: This pack has no version to download.
errors.NOT_A_SHADER: Only shader pack .zip files (with a shaders folder inside) can be added.
errors.SHADER_NESTED: The shader is one folder down. Use the folder inside it instead.
errors.SHADER_NOT_FOUND: This shader isn't in the library or the profile.
errors.SHADER_NO_VERSION: This shader has no version to download.
errors.NOT_A_DATAPACK: Only data pack .zip files (with pack.mcmeta and a data folder) can be added.
errors.DATAPACK_NESTED: The data pack is one folder down inside the zip. Use the folder inside it instead.
errors.DATAPACK_NOT_FOUND: This data pack isn't in the library.
errors.DATAPACK_IN_USE: Worlds still have this data pack.
errors.DATAPACKS_UNSUPPORTED: This world's Minecraft version has no data packs (they came in 1.13).
errors.DATAPACK_NO_VERSION: This project has no data pack to download.

profiles.title: Profiles

duplicateDialog.title: Duplicate {{name}}?
duplicateDialog.body: The copy gets the same version, loader, settings, icon and enabled mods (mods are shared, not downloaded again).
duplicateDialog.noWorlds: It has no worlds to copy.
duplicateDialog.copyHint: Each world is copied: the copy plays its own, and the original's worlds stay as they are. Large worlds take a while and use disk space.
duplicateDialog.running: Close the game first to copy its worlds.

profiles.notFound: This profile doesn't exist any more.

editor.name: Name
editor.memoryHint: The profile's own value replaces the global one.
editor.jvmArgsHint: Replaces the global JVM arguments, e.g. -XX:+UseG1GC
editor.nothingDownloaded: Nothing is downloaded until you press Play.
editor.gameArgsHint: Replaces the global game arguments, e.g. --width 1280
editor.running: Close the game first to change this profile.

changeWarning.title: Change version or loader?
changeWarning.body: Changing the version or loader can break this profile. Worlds opened in an older version can be corrupted, and mods only work with the loader and version they were made for. Back up your worlds first.

applyMods.title: Update mods for the new version?
applyMods.body: Download each mod's version that fits the new Minecraft version and loader. Mods with no matching version are turned off but kept in the library.
applyMods.disabled: Turned off {{count}} mod(s) with no version for this release: {{names}}.
applyMods.unresolved: {{count}} mod(s) aren't from a known site and were left as they are: {{names}}.

deleteDialog.title: Delete {{name}}?
deleteDialog.body: The profile's mods, settings and other files are deleted. Choose what happens to its worlds:
deleteDialog.moveTarget: Profile to move the worlds to

worlds.empty: No worlds yet. Worlds you create in game appear here.
worlds.moveBody: The world will show only in the profile you pick.
worlds.notLinked: This world is stored inside the profile because the data folder doesn't support links, so it can't be moved.
worlds.unassignedBody: These worlds belong to profiles that no longer exist. Give each one a profile to see it again.
worlds.olderWarning: The other profile uses an older version or a different loader.

accounts.label: Account
accounts.renameHint: Renaming keeps the account's UUID, so its progress stays.
accounts.title: Accounts
accounts.deleteBody: The account is only removed from the launcher. Worlds are not touched, so its progress is still there if you add the same name again.
accounts.serverWarning: On offline-mode multiplayer servers a renamed account counts as a new player: those servers work out the UUID from the name.

versionsPage.title: Installed versions
versionsPage.empty: No versions installed yet. They're installed when you play a profile.
versionsPage.deleteBody: This removes the version's files. Shared files and every profile's worlds and settings are kept.
versionsPage.dependents: These installs are built on it and will be deleted too: {{ids}}

mods.title: Mod library
mods.libraryHint: Every mod is stored once here. Tick mods on a profile's Mods tab to use them there.
mods.empty: No mods yet. Add jar files, or drop them here.
mods.drop: Drop .jar files here to add them
mods.removeBody: The mod is deleted from the library.
mods.removeUsed: It is removed from these profiles too: {{names}}
mods.removeUnusedBody: Mods that no profile uses are deleted from the library. You can add them again later.
mods.vanilla: Vanilla profiles can't load mods. Pick Fabric or Quilt on the Settings tab to use mods.
mods.copied: Hard links don't work on this drive, so enabled mods are copied into the profile instead of shared.
mods.locked: {{name}} is needed by {{names}}. Untick those first.
mods.alsoDisabled: Also disabled, as nothing else needs them: {{names}}

bulk.title: Download mods for a version
bulk.body: Pick a Minecraft version and loader. For every mod in your library that came from a mod site, the version that fits is downloaded.
bulk.skipped: {{count}} mod(s) have no version for this release: {{names}}.

remote.title: Add a mod to {{profile}}
remote.noLibraryMatch: No mod with that name in your library.
remote.searchSource: Not in your library. Search Modrinth
remote.notFound: Not found. Only exact names are searched: check the spelling, or try the name from the mod's page.
remote.noVersion: No version for {{game}} with this profile's loader.
remote.missing: Needs {{names}}, which has no version for this profile. Nothing will be downloaded.
remote.incompatible: Doesn't work with {{names}}, enabled in this profile.
remote.nothingToDownload: Everything is already in your library.

validation.checkHint: Also checks every file for damage (takes a moment).

issue.wrongLoader: Made for {{loaders}}, not this profile's loader
issue.duplicateId: Same mod as {{name}}, which is enabled too
issue.java: Needs Java {{range}}, this profile uses Java {{java}}

damaged.unreadable: The file is damaged (it can't be opened)
damaged.sha1: The file is damaged (its contents changed)

unknown.noMetadata: No mod info in the jar: compatibility unknown
unknown.mcVersion: Can't tell which release {{detail}} belongs to

launchProblems.title: Some mods have problems
launchProblems.body: These mods probably won't run as they are.
launchProblems.confirmBody: These mods will be disabled in this profile. They stay in your library, so you can enable them again later.
launchProblems.reasonDependency: needs a mod that gets disabled
launchProblems.loadingPlan: Working out which mods to disable…
launchProblems.warnings_one: Started with {{count}} mod warning. See the Mods tab.
launchProblems.warnings_other: Started with {{count}} mod warnings. See the Mods tab.

backups.runningBlocked: Close the game first to back up its worlds.
backups.unchanged: No changes since the last backup: {{names}}.

dialog.title: Backups of {{name}}
dialog.restoreHint: Restoring unpacks the backup as a separate world in this profile; the current world isn't touched.
dialog.deleteBody: The backup from {{date}} is deleted for good.

dataPacks.title: Data pack library
dataPacks.libraryHint: Every data pack is stored once here. Data packs belong to worlds: add them from a world's Data packs button, or with "Add to worlds…" here.
dataPacks.empty: No data packs yet. Add zip files, or drop them here.
dataPacks.drop: Drop data pack .zip files here to add them
dataPacks.notAdded: Not added or not put in the world: {{files}}
dataPacks.unsupported: Minecraft versions before 1.13 have no data packs.
dataPacks.folderHint: An unzipped data pack in this world only
dataPacks.needsFeatures: Needs experimental features this world doesn't have ({{features}}), so the game won't load it.

dialog.title: Data packs of {{world}}
dialog.hint: Changes take effect the next time the world is opened. New packs are turned on by the game itself.
dialog.none: This world has no data packs.
dialog.noAvailable: Every library data pack is in this world.

toWorlds.title: Add {{name}} to worlds
toWorlds.hint: Pick the worlds that should get this data pack.

notPack.invalid: {{name}}: no data folder (or no pack.mcmeta), so the game can't use it as a data pack.

dataPacks.removeBody: The data pack is deleted from the library.
dataPacks.removeUsed: It is removed from these worlds too: {{names}}
dataPacks.removeUnusedBody: Data packs that no world has are deleted from the library. You can add them again later.

find.title: Find data packs
find.anyVersion: Data packs for every Minecraft version.
find.inWorld: It is in this world now.
find.otherVersion: There is no version for this Minecraft version, so the newest one was downloaded.

shaders.folderHint: An unzipped shader in this profile only
